LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 5.1.1 PRONUNCIATION AND VOCABULARY

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.1: Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary, part of Strand 5 in Grade 6 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why should we pronounce sounds correctly? 2. What information do we obtain when we listen keenly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to correct pronunciation of sounds, words, and phrases from the teacher, audio-visual recordings among others,

2. work with peers to say words and phrases with the sounds /ð / and /θ / and assist one another,

3. listen to a poem on tourist attraction sites in Kenya and recite it.

4. respond to questions on the poem,

5. use the following expressions in sentences: 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to correct pronunciation of sounds, words, and phrases from the teacher, audio-visual recordings among others,
2. work with peers to say words and phrases with the sounds /ð / and /θ / and assist one another,
3. listen to a poem on tourist attraction sites in Kenya and recite it.
4. respond to questions on the poem,
5. use the following expressions in sentences: 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Citizenship: The learner’s sense of patriotism is enhanced as they develop interest in socio-cultural and economic

activities by interacting with poems on Kenya’s tourist attraction sites.

• Self-efficacy: The learner’s ability to pay attention to detail is brought out as they use varied expressions in

sentences to express themselves.
